7 (initially occupied) + 3 (new passengers) = 10 people in total now seated.

Now that there are a total of 19 seats available and only 10 taken, we can subtract to find out how many remain empty:

18 (total number of seats) - 10 (occupied seats) = 8 unoccupied seats left on the train.
